evidence: Modifies test/lint/git-subtree-check.sh and test_runner/src/lint_repo_hygiene.rs with the Tests label.
rationale: Adds a lint check to ensure subtree updates can be backported verbatim without re-verifying newly generated merges. As noted by ryanofsky, it enforces basing subtree updates on previous updates, 'allowing same commits to be merged into multiple branches and saving reviewer effort.'
